wins: Completed comprehensive port/service enumeration within the first six steps, ensuring visibility of exploitable vectors (ep001_step04, ep001_step05).
Captured initial web service fingerprinting data allowing the team to prioritize HTTP attack paths quickly (ep001_step07).
fails: Failed to transition from reconnaissance to exploitation, leaving the target web application unchallenged after identifying it (ep001_step08).
Privilege escalation attempt after obtaining service details was not executed, resulting in zero mission success despite solid early-stage intelligence (ep001_step10).
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reconnaissance workflow yielded actionable intelligence, but the run stalled before exploitation and privilege escalation phases, preventing mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Reconnaissance routinely concluded without initiating exploitation of identified services, leaving key paths untested.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap and bruteforce scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When an HTTP service returns 200-level responses on port 80/443
skill_cards.then_action: Launch directory brute force enumeration with wordlists

skill_cards.if_condition: When a CMS fingerprint is captured on HTTP service
skill_cards.then_action: Run CMS-specific vulnerability scan and attempt credential retrieval

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in establishing awareness of SSH services during reconnaissance.
Effective in capturing initial HTTP surface area that should inform subsequent exploitation.

next_experiments.title: Automated exploitation handoff
next_experiments.description: After completing web service enumeration, immediately trigger CMS-specific scanners and credential harvest workflows to transition into exploitation.

next_experiments.title: Privilege escalation checklist
next_experiments.description: Introduce a scripted privilege escalation checklist after service compromise to ensure the run does not stall before mission completion.
